newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Merrill to review Auckland airport structure - paper.
newsitem.headline: Merrill to review Auckland airport structure - paper.

text.p: Auckland International Airport's two main shareholders have appointed Merrill Lynch to review the company's capital structure, the New Zealand Herald reported on Monday.
The government, holding a 51.6 percent, and the Auckland City Council, 25.8 percent, selected the Auckland arm of the Merill Lynch through a recent tender, the paper said.
Merill Lynch declined to comment on the report. The review is being seen in the financial markets as a precursor to the sale or share market float of the NZ$1 billion asset.
